remarks: Step into effortless elegance in this impeccably maintained 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence at the coveted Rolling Ridge community. Freshly painted throughout, this home showcases beautifully refurbished cabinetry, new designer rugs, new A/C units, and upgraded ceiling fans with integrated lighting. The chef-inspired kitchen includes a new electric grill-perfect for indoor entertaining. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry, a private storage unit, and the freedom of no rental restrictions-ideal for both full-time living and investment potential. The HOA covers heat and hot water, ensuring comfort and value year-round. Rolling Ridge offers a resort-style lifestyle with premium amenities: a pristine in-ground pool, paddle tennis court, serene walking trails, a fenced dog park, picturesque picnic areas, and a tranquil natural pond. Generous parking and manicured grounds complete this luxurious offering. Top floor unit, a truly turnkey opportunity.
